title: Who is prosecutor Keith Flores in Sara Duterte's impeachment trial?
summary: The Senate impeachment court resumed the hearing on Vice President Sara Duterte's alleged unexplained wealth on Tuesday, after a strategic procedural pause the previous day.

blocks.text: The Senate impeachment court resumed the hearing on Vice President Sara Duterte's alleged unexplained wealth on Tuesday, after a strategic procedural pause the previous day.
The impeachment trial continued with witnesses Davao City Register of Deeds IV Kathy Florence Baldonado and City of Samal Deputy Register of Deeds III Marco Pineda.

House prosecutor and Bukidnon 2nd District Rep. Keith Flores presented the title of a 379-square-meter property in Barangay Matina, Davao City, registered under the Vice President’s husband, Manases Carpio.
LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte Impeachment Trial (October 1, 2026)
The property was sold for P6 million in July 2024.
The title also shows an P8-million mortgage with Philippine Savings Bank, which was taken out in August 2024.

Flores also moved to reveal Duterte’s 2026 2025 Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN), but Presiding Officer Francis Escudero pointed out that SALNs do not require officials to indicate the actual area of a property.
Flores, Bukidnon's 2nd District since 2019, is a lawyer.
He was born in Agusan del Norte in April 1972.
Flores earned his law degree at Ateneo de Davao University and was admitted to the Philippine Bar in 2001.
He became a member of the Lakas-Christian Muslim Democrats after taking his oath in 2023.
Flores is serving his third and final term as congressman after winning in the 2019, 2022, and 2025 elections.
Among the bills he authored are the Anti-Political Dynasty Act of 2025, the Anti-Online Gambling Promotion in E-Wallets Act, and the National Water Resources Management Act. —VAL, GMA News
